trigger.reason: BRO (Border Roads Organisation) closes the Rohtang road beyond Marhi after fresh overnight snowfall raises landslide/avalanche risk; permit holders are turned back at the Gulaba checkpoint

original_plan_for_window.quality_note: Permit already purchased for today; the checkpoint closure means the drive up would be turned back entirely if attempted

recovery_plans.label: Reorder: Solang Valley today, Rohtang moved to a later morning
recovery_plans.description: Swap today's slot for Solang Valley — lower altitude, on the same road corridor, and unaffected by the closure. Rohtang Pass is rescheduled to the trip's last available morning, weather permitting.
recovery_plans.tradeoff: Saves 350 rupees and finishes about 110 min earlier, since Solang needs far less travel time than Rohtang. Trades the high-altitude pass views for a lower, safer valley experience today.
recovery_plans.best_for: Travelers with a flexible multi-day itinerary who can reattempt Rohtang on a clearer day

recovery_plans.label: Substitute: skip mountain passes, do Jogini waterfall + hot springs
recovery_plans.description: Drop high-altitude plans entirely for today. Trek to Jogini Waterfall from Vashisht village and soak in the hot springs afterward — both fully local and unaffected by the snow closure.
recovery_plans.tradeoff: Saves 2850 rupees and over 2 hours; trades the high-altitude pass for a waterfall trek and hot springs soak, neither of which is affected by the road closure.
recovery_plans.best_for: Budget-conscious travelers, or those wary of thin-air conditions at 3,978m

recovery_plans.label: Pivot: relaxed Old Manali day with Mall Road evening
recovery_plans.description: Treat the pass as skippable this trip. Spend the day at an easy pace around Hidimba Temple and Old Manali cafes, then shop on Mall Road before a Tibetan-Chinese dinner, folding a normal dinner stop into the plan.

baseline_for_comparison.note: Compare against original window (3050) plus a separate dinner you'd have paid anyway (~500 at Renaissance)

recovery_plans.tradeoff: Costs 2500 less than the original Rohtang excursion plus a normal dinner would have; trades pass views for an easy-paced cultural and shopping day with dinner folded in.
recovery_plans.best_for: Travelers happy to treat the pass as optional and enjoy Manali town at a relaxed pace
